# A.6.5 `disable_statement ::= disable hierarchical_block_identifier ;`
#
# It is an alternative of A.6.4 `analog_event_statement` and of the digital
# A.6.4 `statement`. It is ABSENT from A.6.4 `analog_statement`, so the only
# form an analog block can legally contain is
#
#     @(<event>) disable <named_block>;
#
# This fixture writes `analog begin : work ... disable work; ... end`, i.e.
# `disable` in analog_statement position, which no production derives. The
# rejection is therefore CORRECT behaviour, not a missing feature.
#
# Citation note: there is no clause-5 section for `disable` — 5.11 is
# `jump_statement` (return/break/continue) — so annex A is the citation. The
# engine used to cite "LRM 5.11"; that was wrong and is fixed.
E0401
